_readme: Every code is keyed by system + code. A code's number means nothing on its own: 503 on a Bosch is not 503 on anything else. Each entry needs a source URL on the maker's own site (see the system's source_domains) and the date it was checked, or tests/run.js fails. 'maker_says' and 'maker_fix' summarize the maker's page closely (follow source_url for exact wording); 'plain' is our explanation. source_type is 'help-center' or 'manual'. Run `node tools/build-codes.js` after editing to regenerate the pages in error-codes/. Optional per-code source_label names the document when it isn't the system's default.

bosch-classic.name: Bosch
bosch-classic.label: Bosch 3-digit error codes
bosch-classic.applies: Bosch drive systems that show 3-digit codes on Intuvia, Kiox, Purion, Nyon or SmartphoneHub displays. Purion displays may show only the last two digits (for example 03 for 503). The newer Bosch smart system shows 6-digit codes instead; look those up on Bosch's site for now.
bosch-classic.official_label: Bosch eBike help center: system and error messages
bosch-classic.shop_note: Bikes Plus has diagnostic tools for Bosch and most other major motor systems.

bafang.name: Bafang
bafang.label: Bafang display error codes
bafang.applies: bikes with a Bafang display (the Bafang name or logo is usually on the display or its back), on Bafang mid-drive and hub-motor systems. Displays with a screen keep the last 10 codes in the INFO or ERROR menu. LED-only displays flash the code: the first light flashes the tens digit and the second the units, so two flashes then five is 25.
bafang.official_label: Bafang's service FAQ and display manuals
bafang.display_warning: These are the codes Bafang's own displays use. Many bikes with Bafang or Bafang-style motors have a display made by another company, and its numbers can mean something different. If your display isn't a Bafang one, use that display's manual, or send us a photo.
bafang.shop_note: Bikes Plus works on Bafang and Bafang-style systems all the time.

shimano.name: Shimano
shimano.label: Shimano STEPS error codes
shimano.applies: Shimano STEPS and EP e-bike systems. Codes starting with W are warnings, which clear when conditions improve; codes starting with E are errors, which point to a possible fault. Shimano's E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist app can read the code from the bike.
shimano.display_warning: These are the Shimano codes we could confirm in Shimano's own manuals. Most come from Shimano's Japanese manual for the E8080 system and are translated, so follow each source link for Shimano's exact wording. For any code not listed, use Shimano's official lookup at si.shimano.com/error.
shimano.shop_note: Bikes Plus has diagnostic tools for Shimano and most other major motor systems.

codes.title: Display buttons disabled
codes.maker_says: One or more buttons of the on-board computer are disabled.
maker_fix: Check whether any buttons are stuck, for example from dirt getting in.
Clean the buttons if need be.
codes.plain: A button on the display is stuck or being read as pressed, so the display has switched it off.

codes.title: Operating unit connection problem
codes.maker_says: Connection problem of the operating unit.
maker_fix: Have the connections checked.
codes.plain: The handlebar control unit isn't connecting properly to the rest of the system.

codes.title: Operating unit buttons disabled
codes.maker_says: One or more buttons of the operating unit are disabled.
maker_fix: Check whether any buttons are stuck, for example from dirt getting in.
Clean the buttons if need be.
codes.plain: A button on the handlebar control unit is stuck or being read as pressed.

codes.title: Configuration error
codes.maker_says: Configuration error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system's components aren't set up to work together correctly.

codes.title: Drive unit connection problem
codes.maker_says: Connection problem of the drive unit.
maker_fix: Have the connections checked.
codes.plain: The motor unit isn't connecting properly to the rest of the system.

codes.title: Battery connection problem
codes.maker_says: Connection problem of the eBike battery.
maker_fix: Have the connections checked.
codes.plain: The battery isn't connecting properly to the rest of the system.

codes.title: Communication error between components
codes.maker_says: Communication error between components.
maker_fix: Have the connections checked.
codes.plain: Parts of the system aren't communicating with each other properly.

codes.title: Internal time-out error
codes.maker_says: Internal time-out error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
codes.plain: Something inside the system didn't respond in time. While it's active, the wheel size can't be shown or changed in the settings.

codes.title: Display's internal battery is flat
codes.maker_says: The internal battery of the on-board computer is flat (does not apply to BUI350).
maker_fix: Charge the on-board computer in its holder or through its USB port.
codes.plain: The display's own small built-in battery is empty. This is the display, not the main e-bike battery.

codes.title: Software version error
codes.maker_says: Software version error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The software versions on the system's parts don't match.

codes.title: Drive unit internal fault
codes.maker_says: Internal fault of the drive unit.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The motor unit has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Internal software error
codes.maker_says: Internal software error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system's software has hit an error.

codes.title: USB port error
codes.maker_says: Error at the USB port.
maker_fix: Remove the cable from the on-board computer's USB port.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: There's a problem with whatever is plugged into the display's USB port.

codes.title: Display internal fault
codes.maker_says: Internal fault of the on-board computer.
maker_fix: Have the on-board computer checked.
codes.plain: The display has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Drive unit internal error
codes.maker_says: Internal drive unit error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The motor unit has detected a fault inside itself. It may stop giving assistance.

codes.title: Bike light fault
codes.maker_says: Fault in the bicycle light.
maker_fix: Check the light and its wiring.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: There's a problem with the bike's lights or the wiring to them.

codes.title: Speed sensor error
codes.maker_says: Speed sensor error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system isn't getting a proper signal from the wheel speed sensor. Without it, the motor can't tell how fast you're going and may limit or stop assistance.

codes.title: Speed signal distortion
codes.maker_says: Speed signal distortion detected. Drive assistance is reduced.
maker_fix: Check the position of the spoke magnet and adjust it if necessary.
Check for manipulation (tuning).
codes.plain: The speed signal doesn't look right to the system. Often the magnet on a rear-wheel spoke has moved, or the bike has been tuned to go faster than it should. Assistance is reduced until it's fixed.

codes.title: Internal sensor error
codes.maker_says: Internal sensor error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: One of the system's internal sensors has a fault.

codes.title: Drive unit internal error
codes.maker_says: Internal error of the drive unit.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The motor unit has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Battery error
codes.maker_says: Battery error.
maker_fix: Switch off the eBike.
Remove the eBike battery and reinsert it.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system has detected a problem with the battery.

codes.title: Configuration error
codes.maker_says: Configuration error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system's parts aren't set up to work together. Bosch notes that on Nyon this can mean the motor's software is too old for the display and the dealer needs to update it.

codes.title: Temperature error
codes.maker_says: The eBike is outside the permissible temperature range.
maker_fix: Switch off the eBike system.
Let the drive unit cool down or warm up to the permissible temperature range.
Restart the system.
codes.plain: The motor unit is too hot or too cold to run safely. In Florida, that's usually heat.

codes.title: Impermissible load detected
codes.maker_says: An impermissible load has been detected.
maker_fix: Remove the load.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: Something plugged into the bike's electrical system is drawing power that the system doesn't allow, such as an add-on light or a USB device.

codes.title: Software version error
codes.maker_says: Software version error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The software versions on the system's parts don't match.

codes.title: Authentication error
codes.maker_says: Authentication error.
maker_fix: Switch off the eBike system.
Remove the battery and reinsert it.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system's parts couldn't confirm each other as genuine, matching Bosch components.

codes.title: Incompatible component
codes.maker_says: Incompatible component.
maker_fix: Use a compatible display.
codes.plain: The display (or another part) fitted to the bike isn't compatible with the rest of the system.

codes.title: Configuration error
codes.maker_says: Configuration error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system's components aren't set up to work together correctly.

codes.title: Communication error
codes.maker_says: Communication error.
maker_fix: Check the wiring to the drive unit.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: Parts of the system aren't communicating properly with the motor unit.

codes.title: Communication error
codes.maker_says: Communication error.
maker_fix: Check the wiring to the drive unit.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: Parts of the system aren't communicating properly with the motor unit.

codes.title: Internal battery error
codes.maker_says: Internal battery error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
If it appears while charging: disconnect the charger from the battery, restart the eBike system, then plug the charger back in.
codes.plain: The battery has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Internal battery error
codes.maker_says: Internal battery error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The battery has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Battery temperature error
codes.maker_says: Battery temperature error.
maker_fix: Switch off the eBike system.
Let the battery cool down or warm up to the permissible temperature range.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
If it appears while charging: disconnect the charger and let the battery cool down.
codes.plain: The battery is too hot or too cold to use or charge safely.

codes.title: External battery error
codes.maker_says: External battery error.
maker_fix: Check the wiring.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: There's a problem outside the battery itself, such as its wiring or connection.

codes.title: Battery voltage error
codes.maker_says: Battery voltage error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The system has detected a problem with the battery's voltage.

codes.title: Charger error
codes.maker_says: Charger error.
maker_fix: Replace the charger.
Contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The charger has a fault. Only replace it with a Bosch charger made for your battery.

codes.title: Internal battery error
codes.maker_says: Internal battery error.
maker_fix: Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The battery has detected a fault inside itself.

codes.title: Multiple battery errors
codes.maker_says: Multiple battery errors.
maker_fix: Switch off the eBike system.
Remove the battery and reinsert it.
Restart the system.
If the problem persists, contact your Bosch eBike dealer.
codes.plain: The battery is reporting more than one fault at once.

codes.title: Software version error
codes.maker_says: Software version error.
maker_fix: Contact your Bosch eBike dealer so they can update the software.
codes.plain: The battery's software needs updating by a dealer.

codes.title: Fault in a non-Bosch part
codes.maker_says: Error in a third-party (non-Bosch) component.
maker_fix: Follow the operating instructions from that component's manufacturer.
codes.plain: Any code in the 700s points to a part made by another company, such as a gear hub or shifting system, not to the Bosch system itself.

codes.title: Throttle fault
codes.maker_says: The throttle has a fault. (Some Bafang user manuals list 04 as "the throttle is not back in its correct position" instead; either way, it's the throttle.)
maker_fix: Switch off. Let go of the throttle and check it springs back fully.
Look at the throttle cable and plug for damage. Look; don't pull on it.
If it keeps coming back, Bafang's service steps are for a shop: check the throttle's connection, then replace the throttle if needed.
codes.plain: The system has detected a problem with the throttle. Many bikes won't run the motor while this code shows.

codes.title: Throttle not back in position
codes.maker_says: The throttle is not back in its correct position. (Some Bafang user manuals swap 04 and 05, so 05 can also mean a general throttle fault.)
maker_fix: Let go of the throttle completely and check it springs back on its own.
Switch the system off and on.
If it keeps coming back, Bafang's service steps are for a shop: check the throttle's connection, then replace the throttle if needed.
codes.plain: The throttle is reading as pushed when it shouldn't be, so the motor holds back for safety.

codes.title: Overvoltage protection
codes.maker_says: Overvoltage protection.
maker_fix: Switch off, remove the battery and put it back in, then switch on again.
If it keeps coming back, Bafang's service steps are for a shop: update the controller with Bafang's BESST tool, or replace the battery.
codes.plain: The system has seen a higher voltage than it should and has protected itself. Often this points to the battery, or a battery that doesn't match the system.

codes.title: Motor hall sensor error
codes.maker_says: Error with the hall sensor inside the motor.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will check the motor's connections, and replace the motor if the sensor has failed.
codes.plain: One of the position sensors inside the motor isn't giving a proper signal, so the controller can't drive the motor properly.

codes.title: Motor phase winding fault
codes.maker_says: Fault with the motor phase winding.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will check the motor cable, then replace the motor or controller if needed.
codes.plain: There's a fault in the motor's power wiring or windings.

codes.title: Motor too hot
codes.maker_says: The temperature inside the motor has reached its maximum protection value.
maker_fix: Turn off the system and let the bike cool down.
If it keeps happening after cooling, contact your retailer; Bafang's fix is a replacement motor.
codes.plain: The motor has got too hot and has cut out to protect itself. Long hills, heavy loads and Florida heat make this more likely.

codes.title: Motor temperature sensor error
codes.maker_says: The temperature sensor inside the motor has an error.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
codes.plain: The sensor that watches the motor's temperature has failed, so the system can't protect the motor from overheating.

codes.title: Controller current sensor error
codes.maker_says: An error in the controller's current sensor. (Bafang's FAQ and code sheet title this "Over current of motor".)
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will clear the code and retest, then replace the controller if needed.
codes.plain: The controller can't measure the motor current properly, which it needs for overcurrent protection.

codes.title: Battery temperature sensor error
codes.maker_says: The battery's temperature sensor has a fault.
maker_fix: Switch off and check the battery is seated properly.
If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The sensor that watches the battery's temperature isn't working, so the system can't protect the battery from overheating.

codes.title: Controller too hot
codes.maker_says: The controller's internal temperature has reached its maximum protection value; the motor will not run.
maker_fix: Turn the system off and let it cool down, then restart.
If it keeps happening, contact your retailer. (Bafang's manuals point to the controller; its code sheet points to the motor. A shop can test which.)
codes.plain: The motor controller has got too hot and has stopped the motor to protect itself.

codes.title: Controller temperature sensor error
codes.maker_says: Controller temperature sensor fault.
maker_fix: Switch the system off and on.
If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
codes.plain: The sensor that watches the controller's temperature has failed.

codes.title: Speed sensor error
codes.maker_says: Speed sensor fault.
maker_fix: Switch the system off and on.
Check the magnet on the rear wheel spoke is still there and passes 10–20 mm from the sensor. Don't bend anything.
Check the speed sensor's plug is connected (look; don't pull hard).
If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
codes.plain: The system isn't getting a proper wheel-speed signal, so it may limit or stop assistance.

codes.title: Torque signal error
codes.maker_says: Torque signal fault.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will check the connections, read the sensor with Bafang's BESST tool, update the controller, or replace the torque sensor.
codes.plain: The sensor that measures how hard you're pedaling isn't giving a proper signal, so pedal assist may not work.

codes.title: Torque sensor speed signal error
codes.maker_says: The speed signal of the torque sensor has an error.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will check the connections, run a BESST diagnosis, and replace the torque sensor if needed.
codes.plain: The torque sensor's own speed signal isn't working properly, so pedal assist may not work.

codes.title: Controller overcurrent
codes.maker_says: Overcurrent from the controller.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will update the controller with BESST, then replace it if the problem continues.
codes.plain: The controller has drawn more current than it should and has protected itself.

codes.title: Warning: torque sensor start-up
codes.maker_says: Warning (not an error): the torque sensor's initialization is abnormal.
maker_fix: Restart the system, and don't press hard on the pedals while it starts up.
codes.plain: This is a warning, not a fault. The pedal sensor didn't start up cleanly, usually because there was pressure on the pedals as the bike switched on.

codes.title: Communication problem
codes.maker_says: Communication problem; the motor cannot work.
maker_fix: Check all the visible plugs between the display, motor and battery are pushed fully together.
If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop can run a BESST diagnosis, swap the display or cable, and update the controller software.
codes.plain: The display and the motor controller aren't talking to each other, so the motor won't run.

codes.title: Brake signal error
codes.maker_says: The brake signal has an error (only on bikes with brake sensors).
maker_fix: Squeeze and release both brake levers firmly and check they spring back fully.
If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
codes.plain: The switch that cuts the motor when you brake is sending a faulty signal. Check the brakes themselves work normally before riding.

codes.title: 15V detection circuit fault
codes.maker_says: Fault in the 15V detection circuit.
maker_fix: Please contact your retailer.
codes.plain: An internal power-supply check in the system has failed.

codes.title: Keypad detection circuit fault
codes.maker_says: The detection circuit on the keypad has an error.
maker_fix: Please contact your retailer.
codes.plain: The handlebar button pad has an electrical fault.

codes.title: Controller watchdog fault
codes.maker_says: The controller's WDT (watchdog) circuit is faulty and can't work normally.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will update the controller with BESST, or replace it.
codes.plain: A built-in safety check inside the controller has failed.

codes.title: Sensor watchdog fault
codes.maker_says: The sensor's WDT (watchdog) circuit is faulty.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will update the sensor with BESST, or replace it.
codes.plain: A built-in safety check inside one of the sensors has failed.

codes.title: Battery voltage too high
codes.maker_says: The battery's total voltage is too high.
maker_fix: Stop using the battery and contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The battery's overall voltage is above what the system allows.

codes.title: Battery voltage too low
codes.maker_says: The battery's total voltage is too low.
maker_fix: Charge the battery.
If it still shows, contact your retailer; Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The battery is too empty for the system to run. This code only appears on systems with Bafang's smart battery management.

codes.title: Battery cell voltage too high
codes.maker_says: The voltage of a single battery cell is too high.
maker_fix: Stop using the battery and contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: One of the cells inside the battery is at a higher voltage than it should be.

codes.title: Battery too hot
codes.maker_says: The battery temperature is too high.
maker_fix: Switch off and let the bike and battery cool down, out of direct sun.
codes.plain: The battery is too hot to use safely. In Florida, a bike left in the sun or a hot car can get there quickly.

codes.title: Battery too cold
codes.maker_says: The battery temperature is too low.
maker_fix: Bring the battery to room temperature before riding or charging.
codes.plain: The battery is too cold to use safely.

codes.title: Battery charge too high
codes.maker_says: The battery's state of charge is too high.
maker_fix: Stop using the battery and contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The battery reports a charge level above what the system allows.

codes.title: Battery charge too low
codes.maker_says: The battery's state of charge is too low.
maker_fix: Charge the battery.
If it still shows, contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The battery reports that it's too empty.

codes.title: Battery cell voltage too low
codes.maker_says: A single cell's discharge voltage is too low.
maker_fix: Stop using the battery and contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: One of the cells inside the battery has dropped too low. This code only appears on systems with Bafang's smart battery management.

codes.title: Battery cells out of balance
codes.maker_says: The voltage difference between battery cells is too large.
maker_fix: Stop using the battery and contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement battery.
codes.plain: The cells inside the battery are at very different voltages. This code only appears on systems with Bafang's smart battery management.

codes.title: Gear shift detection fault
codes.maker_says: Gear shift detection defect.
maker_fix: Check the gear shifter isn't jammed.
If it continues, contact your retailer; Bafang's fix is a replacement shifter.
codes.plain: The system can't detect the gear shifter properly.

codes.title: Electronic derailleur stuck
codes.maker_says: The electronic derailleur cannot release.
maker_fix: Contact your retailer. Bafang's fix is a replacement derailleur.
codes.plain: The electronic gear changer is stuck.

codes.title: Electronic lock jammed
codes.maker_says: The electronic lock is jammed.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will update the display with BESST, or replace the lock.
codes.plain: The bike's electronic lock is stuck.

codes.title: Bluetooth module error
codes.maker_says: The Bluetooth module has an error.
maker_fix: If the problem continues, contact your retailer or a shop that works on Bafang systems.
A shop will re-load the display software with BESST, or replace the display.
codes.plain: The display's Bluetooth part has a fault. The bike may still ride normally.

codes.title: Drive unit is hot
codes.maker_says: The drive unit temperature is high. Assist is lower than usual.
maker_fix: Stop using the assist and let the drive unit cool down.
codes.plain: The motor has got hot, so it's giving less help to protect itself. Long climbs, heavy loads and Florida heat make this more likely.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Speed can't be detected
codes.maker_says: Travel speed can't be detected. The speed sensor may be out of position, or the magnet on the brake disc rotor may have come off. The top assisted speed is reduced.
maker_fix: Check that the speed sensor and its magnet on the brake disc rotor are in place.
codes.plain: The bike can't read how fast it's going, so it limits the assist.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Pedal sensor didn't start up properly
codes.maker_says: Torque sensor initialization didn't finish normally. Assist may be weaker than usual. (On DU-E5000/E5080 with newer firmware this warning is numbered W106.)
maker_fix: Switch off, take your feet off the pedals, and switch on again.
If it keeps happening, contact your dealer.
codes.plain: The sensor that measures how hard you pedal didn't start up cleanly, usually because there was weight on the pedals at switch-on.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Battery temperature out of range
codes.maker_says: The battery is outside its guaranteed operating temperature. Battery output is shut off.
maker_fix: Too hot: leave the battery somewhere cool, out of direct sun, until it cools.
Too cold: bring it indoors until it warms up.
codes.plain: The battery is too hot or too cold to use, so it has switched its power off. A bike left in the Florida sun can get there quickly.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Wrong type of derailleur connected
codes.maker_says: A different derailleur from the configured one is connected (for example, electronic where mechanical is set). Shifting isn't possible.
maker_fix: Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The system is set up for one kind of gear changer but sees another, so it won't shift.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: System error
codes.maker_says: A system error was detected. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Press the battery's power button to turn the system on again.
Keep your feet off the pedals when you switch on.
codes.plain: The system has detected an error and stopped the assist.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Drive unit firmware fault
codes.maker_says: An abnormality was detected in the drive unit's firmware. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The motor's software has a problem. A shop can reload or update it.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Speed sensor may be out of position
codes.maker_says: The speed sensor may be installed in the wrong position. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The speed sensor isn't where the system expects it, so the assist is switched off.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Battery and drive unit not communicating
codes.maker_says: Communication error between the battery and the drive unit. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Check the cable between the battery and the drive unit is connected properly.
Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The battery and the motor aren't talking to each other.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Battery not supported by this system
codes.maker_says: The battery meets the system's standards but isn't supported by this drive unit. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Press the battery's power button to restart it.
Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The battery fitted isn't one this motor supports. Use the battery made for your system.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Battery doesn't meet system standards
codes.maker_says: The battery doesn't meet the system's standards. No system functions start.
maker_fix: Restart the battery.
Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The bike doesn't recognize the battery as a compatible one. Use only the battery made for your system.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Battery doesn't recognize the drive unit
codes.maker_says: The battery doesn't recognize the drive unit. (Shown as one flash of the battery's light.)
maker_fix: Use a genuine Shimano battery.
Check the power cable.
Contact your distributor or dealer.
codes.plain: The battery can't identify the motor it's connected to.

codes.title: Firmware not supported
codes.maker_says: The current firmware isn't supported by this system. The system won't start and assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Update all parts to the latest firmware with Shimano's E-TUBE PROJECT app, or have a dealer do it.
codes.plain: The software on the bike's parts doesn't match. An update fixes it.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Display firmware may be corrupted
codes.maker_says: Part of the cycle computer's firmware may be corrupted. Assist isn't available.
maker_fix: Contact the shop where you bought the bike, or a Shimano dealer.
codes.plain: The display's software has a problem. A shop can reload it.
codes.source_label: Shimano STEPS E8080 user manual (Japanese, translated)

codes.title: Tampering detected
codes.maker_says: Tampering detected: the product doesn't comply with national or regional standards. Switching the power off and on clears it for now; if it happens too many times, the system goes to E299.
maker_fix: Return the bike to its original setup, then switch the power off and on.
codes.plain: The system thinks the bike has been modified to go faster than the rules allow. On EP8, EP6 and EP5 systems.

codes.title: Safe Mode
codes.maker_says: Safe Mode: drive unit assist stops. Only a Shimano office or authorized distributor can release it with special equipment, and Shimano says it may not be possible to release.
maker_fix: Contact a Shimano dealer or distributor.
codes.plain: The assist has been shut off for good after repeated tampering alerts. On EP8, EP6 and EP5 systems.
